name: marginalia
description: Marginalia workspace: the bot (api), the studio (ui) and their contract (packages/contract).

scripts.start: npm run build && npm --workspace api start
scripts.dev: npm run build && concurrently -k -n contract,api,run,studio -c gray,blue,cyan,magenta "npm --workspace @worldia/marginalia-contract run build -- -w --preserveWatchOutput" "npm --workspace api run build -- -w --preserveWatchOutput" "npm --workspace api start -- --watch" "npm run studio:dev"
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run studio:build && npm run init
scripts.init: npm run build && npm --workspace api run init
scripts.doctor: npm run build && npm --workspace api run doctor --
scripts.autostart: npm run build && npm --workspace api run autostart --
scripts.test: npm run build && npm --workspace api test
scripts.eval: npm run build && npm --workspace api run eval --
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace @worldia/marginalia-contract run build && npm --workspace api run typecheck
scripts.posthog:backfill: npm run build && npm --workspace api run posthog:backfill --
scripts.build: npm --workspace @worldia/marginalia-contract run build && npm --workspace api run build
